meta.name: paid-ads-launch
meta.description: Plan and prepare a new paid-media campaign or cross-channel test before it can spend. Use when asked to create, launch, start, set up, or allocate budget to an advertising campaign on any supported platform.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为付费广告投放做好计划与筹备
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正要为广告投放做计划,却不知从何入手
copy.tagline_en: Get your paid ad campaign planned and ready to launch
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're planning an ad campaign and need a clear starting point.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude会在投放前规划广告:先核对转化目标、预算、落地页等,信息不足就不给花费计划;会选择最小可行测试,并产出含测量、渠道、预算、信息链、实验、就绪状态的预检简报;只经已验证接口创建暂停广告。
howto.when: 当你提出创建、启动或设置受支持平台的广告活动等要求时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建并启动一个Google搜索广告活动,日预算500元。
say.note: 它会先确认转化目标、落地页等关键信息。

say.text: 我要在Meta上测试一个视觉广告,预算1万美元。
say.note: 它会选择最小可行测试并设定期望的观察期。

say.text: 为LinkedIn的B2B广告活动分配预算并准备简报。
say.note: 它会核对审批人并输出含排除条件的简报。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude plans paid ads pre-spend: gates on essentials (conversion, budget, URL); picks narrowest viable test; produces preflight brief (measurement, channel, budget, message, experiment, readiness); creates paused ads only via verified connectors.
howto.when_en: Triggers when asked to create, launch, start, set up, or allocate budget to an ad campaign on a supported platform.

say_en.text: Create and launch a Google Search campaign with a daily budget of 500 CNY.
say_en.note: It confirms conversion goal and landing page first.

say_en.text: I want to test a visual ad on Meta with a $10k budget.
say_en.note: It picks the narrowest viable test and sets an observation window.

say_en.text: Allocate budget for a LinkedIn B2B campaign and prepare the brief.
say_en.note: It verifies the approver and outputs exclusions in the brief.
